notes.title: UPDATE: Pre-release update, take 1
notes.content:
As we get ready to leave Early Access we'll be fixing some lingering bugs and satisfying some last-minute feature requests. Here's what's in today's update:

[list]
[*] Added copy solution buttons to the puzzle selection UI.
[*] Added new textures for many of the factory blocks.
[*] Added a new tutorial image for the second puzzle.
[*] Added more cases where factory blocks are detached at runtime (specifically, from the "active" faces of sensors and welders).
[*] Added a button for the downward counter to the block type UI.
[*] Removed the survey from the puzzle completion UI. Thanks for all the feedback you've provided during Early Access!
[*] Improved the mouse sensitivity option to have more range at the lower end.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could bind the same key to two or more in-game actions.
[*] Fixed a bug where factory blocks didn't have their symmetry correctly set, making it difficult to create puzzles with solutions that include factory blocks.
[*] Fixed a rendering bug with painted surfaces passing behind holograms.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game could get "stuck" when bringing up the escape menu during a visual fade transition.
[*] Fixed a bug where it was impossible to build on the sides of toggle switches.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: Infiniupdate #3
notes.content:
Infiniupdate #3 has been released! Read more about it here:

http://www.zachtronics.com/infiniupdate-3

[h1]New Content[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new mini-campaign, Atropos Station, which includes six new puzzles about building things from inputs that require processing (i.e. evisceration).
[*] Added a new mini-campaign, The Homeward Fleet, which includes six new puzzles about building massive products.
[*] Added a new block type, the counter, which is a sensor that remembers how many blocks it has detected and triggers on a particular count.
[*] Added a new block type, the painter, which sprays paint on the sides of other blocks as they pass by.
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an "advanced" level editor, which allows you to build puzzles using the same tools that we use!
[*] Added a new metric, block count, which tracks the number of blocks in your factory other than platforms.
[*] Added Steam trading cards.
[*] Added more Steam achievements.
[*] Added tips to the loading screen.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Blocks unlocked in the second campaign can now be used in every level of the second campaign.
[*] You can now point at blocks you didn't build when using the area select tool.
[*] Fixed a bug where extruded metal would flash red when eviscerated.
[*] Added lots of performance improvements to rendering, saving, and the simulation.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: Miscellaneous bug fixes
notes.content:
Today's update fixes a few miscellaneous bugs, including some lingering issues in the Linux build.
[list]
[*] Linux now saves to $XDG_DATA_HOME instead of always saving to "~/.local/share". If you have $XDG_DATA_HOME set to something other than "~/.local/share" you may have to move your save files manually.
[*] Fixed a serious memory leak by rewriting our audio system. If you notice any new sound-related bugs, please let us know!
[*] Fixed a bug where the area select tool could be used to move blocks into inputs and outputs, where you're normally not allowed to build.
[*] Fixed a Linux-specific bug that caused players to sometimes go out of bounds when climbing stairs.
[*] Fixed a Linux-specific bug that caused some audio logs and cinematic sequences to crash the game.
[/list]

[*] Fixed a bug where the area select tool could be used to move blocks into inputs and outputs, where you're normally not allowed to build.
[*] Fixed a Linux-specific bug that caused players to sometimes go out of bounds when climbing stairs.
[*] Fixed a Linux-specific bug that caused some audio logs and cinematic sequences to crash the game.

notes.title: UPDATE: Infiniupdate #1
notes.content:
The Infiniupdate #1 patch has been released. More information is available [url=http://zachtronics.com/infiniupdate-1/]here[/url].
[h1]NEW CONTENT[/h1]                        [list]                            [*]A new mini-campaign, The Heist, has been added to the game. It adds seven puzzles to the game and introduces a new mechanic, teleportation, and a new block type, the upside-down conveyor.[/*]                        [/list]                        [h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]                        [list]                            [*]A simple area selection tool has been added, which allows you to quickly select a group of blocks and move or delete it with a single click. It is available in the block menu and can be added to the hotbar.[/*]                            [*]Voice-over captions are now available, and can be turned on in the options menu.[/*]                            [*]You can now crouch by holding the jetpack descend key when on the ground. Now you can see the underside of blocks you could previously only imagine![/*]                            [*]You can now rate user-created puzzles in the score window that shows immediately after solving them.[/*]                            [*]You can now scroll through custom and user-created puzzles.[/*]                            [*]Your save file is now automatically backed up, in case a power outage, computer crash, or 12 year-old hacker corrupts your save file.[/*]                            [*]An option to disable anti-aliasing has been added to the options menu. It is still on by default.[/*]                            [*]A volume slider to turn down the ambient background sounds has been added to the options menu. There were so many requests for this![/*]                        [/list]                        [h1]BALANCE FIXES[/h1]                        [list]                            [*]A handful of puzzles from the second, third, and fifth planets have been tweaked to be easier to solve. As a result, you may have to re-solve some of them.[/*]                            [*]Platform blocks can no longer be eviscerated. Our deepest condolences go out to the scuzz block enthusiast community.[/*]                        [/list]                        [h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]                        [list]                            [*]Changes to input rate are now included as undo/redo events.[/*]                            [*]A bug that caused animated GIFs to record as solid gray images on OS X has been fixed.[/*]                            [*]Many bugs involving the block simulation and audio have been fixed.[/*]                        [/list]

tags.feature: A new mini-campaign, The Heist, has been added to the game. It adds seven puzzles to the game and introduces a new mechanic, teleportation, and a new block type, the upside-down conveyor.

A simple area selection tool has been added, which allows you to quickly select a group of blocks and move or delete it with a single click. It is available in the block menu and can be added to the hotbar.
Voice-over captions are now available, and can be turned on in the options menu.
You can now crouch by holding the jetpack descend key when on the ground. Now you can see the underside of blocks you could previously only imagine!
You can now rate user-created puzzles in the score window that shows immediately after solving them.
You can now scroll through custom and user-created puzzles.
Your save file is now automatically backed up, in case a power outage, computer crash, or 12 year-old hacker corrupts your save file.
An option to disable anti-aliasing has been added to the options menu. It is still on by default.
A volume slider to turn down the ambient background sounds has been added to the options menu. There were so many requests for this!

tags.balance_change: A handful of puzzles from the second, third, and fifth planets have been tweaked to be easier to solve. As a result, you may have to re-solve some of them.
Platform blocks can no longer be eviscerated. Our deepest condolences go out to the scuzz block enthusiast community.

tags.bug: Changes to input rate are now included as undo/redo events.
A bug that caused animated GIFs to record as solid gray images on OS X has been fixed.
Many bugs involving the block simulation and audio have been fixed.

notes.title: UPDATE: Recording and hotbar improvements, and more!
notes.content:
[h1]Recording Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] The animated GIF recorder now supports solutions that create multiple products in parallel.
[*] The animated GIF recorder now exports at a higher resolution by default.
[/list]
[h1]Hotbar Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] After many requests, it is now possible to scroll through the slots in the hotbar!
[*] There are now three different persisted hotbars: one for campaign levels and the sandbox, one for editing custom puzzles, and one for playing custom puzzles.
[*] Empty hotbar slots are now hidden when the block type menu is closed.
[*] You can now drag blocks out of the hotbar to remove them, or drag them into another slot to swap the slot contents.
[/list]
[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] The default key for toggling alternate block types is now C, not Alt.
[*] Blocks are no longer placed when clicking back into the game to give it focus.
[*] Input and output preview holograms now "duck" out of the way when product blocks are present.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a moving block could clip through a rotating block without colliding.
[*] Fixed a bug where two rotating blocks could clip through each other without colliding.
[*] Fixed a bug where lifters would sometimes hold blocks in place and prevent them from moving.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor could become stuck when completing a level with the Steam overlay open.
[*] Fixed a bug on OS X where GIFs and custom level previews were not properly captured.
[*] Fixed a bug on OS X that made it impossible to switch to another window without first exiting the game.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: Animated GIF creation!
notes.content:
Today's update contains mostly bug fixes and art tweaks, but it also includes an exciting new feature: automatic animated GIF creation!

If you press the recording key (F10 by default) on a puzzle that you have solved, an animated GIF of your solution will be recorded and saved to your desktop. The GIF is automatically compressed and made to loop seamlessly, so all you need to do is upload it to the internet!

notes.title: UPDATE: Mac support, new art, alternate block type toggle, and more!
notes.content:
Today's update includes a lot of changes!
[list]
[*] Infinifactory now supports Mac OS X!
[*] Production Zone 2 has new, better looking textures.
[*] If you press the toggle type key (default: Alt) while looking at a block with an alternate type, like a welder or rotator, it will switch the block to the other type.
[*] V-sync can now be enabled in the options menu.
[*] You can now stop playback from within the product error UI by pressing the stop playback (default: R) key.
[*] If you have an AZERTY keyboard, your controls will now default to something more AZERTY-friendly.
[*] Fixes for assorted crashes and bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: Sandbox, rotation changes
notes.content:
We launched a pretty big update tonight, with the following changes:
[list]
[*] There is now a sandbox (the "test zone") that is unlocked after beating Skydock 19 (the second set of puzzles). It includes a new block, the toggle switch, which allows you to directly interact with your factory.
[*] We changed the way that rotators work so that it's much easier to rotate single blocks. To reflect this new behavior, we also changed the first puzzle, which you may need to re-solve in order to pick up where you left off.
[*] Cycle scores for puzzles should now be consistent between the first and subsequent runs of solutions.
[*] There are now instructions for the "juicer".
[*] The sensor is now silent. Our gracious hosts may be insensitive, but they're not [i]that[/i] malicious.
[*] Lots of other bug fixes and updates to sound and art assets.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: Bug fixes, hotbar slots
notes.content: We just pushed a new build to Steam that fixes a bunch of bugs, including a particularly awkward bug where other people's Steam Workshop levels were floating in an unplayable blue void. We've also added a few more slots to the hotbar, although we might still do more with the hotbar soon.

notes.content: We just pushed a new build to Steam that, most notably, adds an option for inverting the mouse y-axis. I don't know how people play with it like that, but there sure are a lot of you so we made it a top priority to fix!
